long_biography.plain_text:
Towergate became the first platform for the business that would become The Ardonagh Group. Ross took charge during a difficult restructuring and stabilized its operations, finances and governance. He also advised investors HPS and Madison Dearborn as they acquired additional insurance businesses. Their merger created Ardonagh, with Ross as group chief executive.

His earlier career had spanned 25 years at Arthur J. Gallagher, ending as CEO of its international division. At Ardonagh, Ross retained specialist management teams while using shared capital, data and scale to support expansion. The model produced regional platforms across Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America alongside the UK and London market. A 2025 equity investment valued the privately held group at $14 billion.
